note: One entry per game. The card fields drive the /games/ gallery, the home page, the footer, the sitemap and llms.txt. A game with a `content` file also gets its own page at `slug`. `play` is the tool page that runs the game (its facts live in tools.json under the same id).

games.name: The Plenum
games.sizzle: Play a card and watch the numbers it changed.
games.line: A card game where the whole game is one array of exact numbers. Every card you play is one operation on that array, and the cells it changed light up beside your hand.
games.teaches: Each card shows the exact call it makes, so you can see what an operation does: count a tag, flip it across the whole Board, bind two cards into one.
games.powers: Runs on the Pleroma in Phasor. Every move, draw and score is a call on it, and there is no other game state.
games.phone: Laid out for a phone screen: one column, 44 px tap targets.
